import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for survived/not survived
survival_palette = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
survival_labels = {0: 'Did Not Survive', 1: 'Survived'}

# Plot 1: Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Age Distribution by Survival Status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
for survived in [0, 1]:
    subset = df_age[df_age['survived'] == survived]['age']
    ax2.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=survival_labels[survived], 
             color=survival_palette[survived], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(title='Survival Status')
ax2.axvline(df_age['age'].mean(), color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='Mean Age')

# Plot 3: Survival Count by Embarkation Town
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[survival_palette[0], survival_palette[1]], 
                      edgecolor='black', width=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend([survival_labels[0], survival_labels[1]], title='Survival Status', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Fare vs Age colored by Survival with Class distinction
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_plot = df.dropna(subset=['age', 'fare'])
markers = {1: 'o', 2: 's', 3: '^'}
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    for survived in [0, 1]:
        subset = df_plot[(df_plot['pclass'] == pclass) & (df_plot['survived'] == survived)]
        ax4.scatter(subset['age'], subset['fare'], 
                   c=survival_palette[survived], 
                   marker=markers[pclass],
                   alpha=0.5, s=30,
                   label=f'Class {pclass} - {survival_labels[survived]}')
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age (by Class and Survival)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
# Create custom legend
handles, labels = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(handles[:6], labels[:6], loc='upper right', fontsize=7, ncol=2, title='Class & Survival')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
